text.es: Yo lo que quiero es recuperar el tiempo perdido y pasar mi vida contigo. Ser feliz. Disfrutarte. Quizás sí, quizá podamos volver a creer en el destino.
text.en: What I want is to make up for lost time and spend my life with you. To be happy. To savor you. Maybe, just maybe, we can believe in fate again.
